newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder cuts M.S. Carriers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder cuts M.S. Carriers.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim analyst Gregory Burns said he removed M.S. Carriers Inc from its recommended list and downgraded it to a "perform in line" rating and cut his earnings estimates on the company for 1997 and 1998.
-- The stock closed at 16-3/4 Thursday after issuing a warning that it expected to report earnings of $0.16 to $0.19 per share in the current quarter, well below Wall Street expectations.
